With no tile taken, idle closes the view instead of pausing; idle also fires when every frame fails conversion (tested)
A hidden page noticed first through a frame pauses with the tiles like the visibilitychange handler; a hidden board region still closes to idle (tested, the region case asserts idle)
Voice trouble counts carry across a camera switch (tested, documented)
